headline: LAA @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAA 4.74 at DET 3.78, with a projected total of 8.52. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: LAA moved +1.27 runs while DET moved -0.53, changing the projected margin by +1.81 runs. The projected total climbed +0.74, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -26.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jack Flaherty has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Kevin McGonigle, Nolan Schanuel, Jorge Soler, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Zach McKinstry, Riley Greene because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
